verifier: Commons file pages read for this pass. Not an independent legal opinion.
processing: Each file was redrawn to grayscale, given a light grain, cover-cropped to 500×700, and saved as JPEG with an APP0 marker only. No EXIF, GPS, APP1 or APP13.
cache: These JPEGs are not in the service-worker precache. The first request for a card's photo is stored by the existing runtime cache, so a photo already shown still loads offline. The first install does not download the pool.
gaps: Marx pool is three photographs (1861 Beard, 1875 Mayall, 1882 NYPL clipping). The 1872 Bundesarchiv file was removed because it is CC BY-SA 3.0 de and its attribution could not be guaranteed on the card front, in GIF/APNG frames, and through QR receipt.
Marx 1875 uses {{PD/1923|1901}} on the Commons file, photographer John Jabez Edwin Mayall, sitting before 24 August 1875. Not treated as a blocker.
Engels: five photographs. Coloured versions of the same sittings were not added.

Mao Zedong with cap.jpg was removed (PD-China only; US/URAA status not established). Mao Zedong 1937.jpg (Edgar Snow, cc-zero on the file) was removed because that tag does not by itself clear the underlying 1937 photograph. Remaining Mao files are the 1920, 1935 and 1940 portraits already in this manifest.

Kim Il Sung during 1946 elections.jpg and Kim Il-sung in 1950.jpg were removed. The 1946 file's upload date and author field were not reliable, and PD-North Korea plus PD-old-50 do not establish US status. The 1950 file's PD-North Korea and PD-1996 claim was not backed by a verified publication history here. The 1927 portrait (PD-China and PD-US on the file) remains. Four further images (kim-banquet, kim-podium, kim-map, kim-coat) were added from a contributor public-domain assertion only. No source page, date, or photographer was supplied or matched. kim-coat shows brushwork and canvas texture in the supplied image and may be a painting. Those four are not independently verified.
Castro remains one photograph: 15 April 1959, PD-USNWR, MATS terminal, Washington.
No crop, flip or tint of one photograph was given a second id. fetchedPixels is the download used to make the JPEG, at most 1400 px wide, not always the master scan.
Lenin 1921 is a small scan and looks soft. Pool sizes were not padded after these removals.

removed.reason: Removed. Commons file Karl Marx in 1872.png is CC BY-SA 3.0 de (Bundesarchiv). The required attribution, licence URL, and a notice that the file was cropped, turned grayscale and grained would have to travel on the card front, in GIF and APNG frames, and through QR send and receipt. Receipt currently replaces the credit with "photo travelled by QR", and the QR credit field is capped at 200 characters. That is not a clean way to keep a ShareAlike credit, so the file is not shipped. No replacement sitting was added.
Removed. File:Mao_Zedong_with_cap.jpg carries PD-China only. US status, including URAA restoration, was not established.
Removed. File:Mao_Zedong_1937.jpg is tagged cc-zero, author Edgar Snow, date 1937. A CC0 tag on that file does not by itself show that the 1937 photograph is free of the photographer's copyright.

Removed. File:Kim_Il_Sung_during_1946_elections.jpg. The file's machine date was an upload date, not a demonstrated capture date, and the author field was not a reliable photographer credit. PD-North Korea and PD-old-50 do not establish US status. A claimed 1948 Soviet publication would also complicate which country's law applies. Held out until there is a clearer record.
Removed. File:Kim_Il-sung_in_1950.jpg is tagged PD-North Korea and PD-1996. The publication history behind that claim was not verified. Held out until there is a clearer record.
